marco-partnerships: Quick sync: partner wants a 'no-code' connector demo that ingests from Snowflake into our vector store (Qdrant) via Databricks. Need checklist: service account, demo dataset, marketplace copy, and a runbook for failover to dedicated capacity.

julia-eng: I'll provision svc_marketplace_demo in partner-sandbox and attach labels partner=terra_co, demo=marketplace_no_code. Which Snowflake tenant?

pete-soleng: For the demo dataset we'll use 300 customer support tickets plus metadata (date, product). We'll test embeddings -> index -> semantic search -> rerank. Need token-level cost visible and a short latency SLA to show in slide.

nina-snowflake: I'll prepare a stage and grant GET on the stage to svc_marketplace_demo_role. Also can add a sample COPY INTO statement to the runbook.

CREATE ROLE svc_marketplace_demo_role;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE demo_db TO ROLE svc_marketplace_demo_role;
-- restrict to staging schema
```
